title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
abstract: arXiv:2610.39423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. translated_title: FDSML：基于参数感知三元组损失的公式驱动监督度量学习
translated_abstract: 公式驱动监督学习（FDSL）能够在无需真实图像的情况下进行视觉预训练，但现有方法将预训练任务转化为对离散化标签的分类，从而丢弃了生成过程中的连续性信息。我们提出公式驱动监督度量学习（FDSML），它超越离散类别标签，直接从图像生成参数中获取关系监督。FDSML 结合了 FineFractalDB——我们改进的分形数据集，具有更高的类内多样性和更稳定的结构——以及参数感知三元组（PA-Triplet）损失，该损失根据底层迭代函数系统（IFS）参数空间中的距离来划分正样本和负样本。这一目标函数使训练得到的嵌入能够遵循由参数导出的相对相似度排序。实验表明，FDSML 提升了模型向图像检索任务的迁移能力，同时在下游分类任务上保持竞争力，并在多种图像损坏设置下提高了鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出 FDSML 方法，利用参数感知三元组损失直接从图像生成参数（而非离散类别标签）中提取关系监督，并结合改进的分形数据集 FineFractalDB，显著提升了图像检索迁移能力和模型鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FDSML, which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters (rather than discrete class labels) via a Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss and a refined fractal dataset FineFractalDB, improving transferability to image retrieval and robustness.
